findings.message: The staged set includes packages/codictator/src/cli/human-gate.ts, packages/codictator/tests/unit/adapters/hook-injection-prompt-dedupe.test.ts and packages/codictator/tests/unit/cli/cli-harness-render.test.ts, none of which is in files.allow. Nothing blocks (record plus historyStaged skips the writes gate at commit), but amend the allow list so the record matches the change.

Each L0 hook call renders the scoped injection twice with identical inputs (injectionForReply for the reply, then renderInjectionContent again inside emitInjectionEvent for the audit event), re-reading task records each time. Consider rendering once and sharing the text; behavior is identical either way, this is render cost only.
